title: Model mapping file
description: Optional. Adjusts how Claude Code model IDs are presented to Claude Desktop. models is an ARRAY, not an object keyed by model ID, because model IDs routinely contain dots (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5) and the macOS implementation must address entries by numeric index using plutil, which cannot traverse a dictionary key containing a dot. It cannot invent model IDs unless the caller passes --allow-unlisted-models.

id.description: The exact model ID as it appears in the Claude Code settings.

labelOverride.description: Text shown in the Desktop model picker.

supports1m.description: Only set when the deployment really accepts 1M-token context for this model.

behavesAs.description: A Claude model ID such as claude-sonnet-5, for gateway aliases the app cannot identify. Region prefixes, dates and upper case are tolerated by the app; a bare family name without 'claude-' is ignored.
